```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

data <- readRDS("pbp2014-2024.rds")

# Distribution of Yards Gained by Play Type
yard_dist <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(yards_gained)) %>%
  group_by(play_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_yards = mean(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_yards = median(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_yards = sd(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_yards = min(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_yards = max(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(yard_dist)

# 4th Down Decision Probabilities
fourth_down_choices <- data %>%
  filter(down == 4) %>%
  mutate(decision = case_when(
    play_type == "punt" ~ "punt",
    play_type == "field_goal" ~ "field_goal",
    TRUE ~ "go_for_it"
  )) %>%
  group_by(yardline_100, ydstogo, decision) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(yardline_100, ydstogo) %>%
  mutate(prob = count / sum(count)) %>%
  select(yardline_100, ydstogo, decision, prob)

print(fourth_down_choices)

# Field Goal Success Rates by Distance
fg_success <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(field_goal_result) & play_type == "field_goal") %>%
  mutate(made_fg = ifelse(field_goal_result == "made", 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(kick_distance) %>%
  summarise(
    fg_attempts = n(),
    fg_made = sum(made_fg),
    fg_success_rate = mean(made_fg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(fg_success)

write_csv(yard_dist, "yard_distribution.csv")
write_csv(fourth_down_choices, "fourth_down_probabilities.csv")
write_csv(fg_success, "fg_success_rates.csv")

```
